hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.astro|*.mjs|*.cjs) out=$(npx eslint --fix --no-warn-ignored "$f" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; }
